activity.unknown: No confirmed progress snapshot is available.
activity.needs_review: Review required — backup is not fully complete
activity.reviewHint: These files are not completed. Independent files can continue. Skipping keeps the unresolved record; no unverified result is adopted or overwritten.
activity.issuesUnavailable: Current review records could not be verified. Last observed records cannot be acted on; refresh to retry.
activity.actionFailed: The action did not confirm a result. Refresh the records before retrying.
activity.noIssues: No unresolved WebDAV records were returned.

errors.access_denied: Access was denied. Check credentials and permissions.
errors.storage_full: The destination has no space or quota left.
errors.source_changed: The source changed. The previous version was not completed.
errors.configuration_required: Select sources and verify the destination before backing up.
errors.interrupted: The process stopped before a completed result was confirmed.
errors.settings_changed: Stopped because settings changed. Completed files and recovery records are preserved.
errors.retry_exhausted: All five access attempts were used. User action is required.
errors.review_required: Some files require review; the backup is not fully complete.
errors.backup_busy: A backup is already using the current context.
errors.unknown: The backup result could not be confirmed. Check the recorded state before retrying.

onboarding.sourceDescription: Kloda transfers directly to your personal storage.
onboarding.desktopBackgroundHint: Scheduled backups run only while Kloda is open or running in the system tray. Quitting stops scheduled backups.
onboarding.storageDescription: WebDAV access and write permission are verified before backup starts.

pairing.title: Pair your phone
pairing.description: Establish local device trust on the same Wi-Fi or Ethernet LAN. No account, internet connection or file permission is required for pairing.
pairing.invitationDescription: Create a private, short-lived QR code, then explicitly approve the phone that connects.
pairing.readOnlyStatus: Read-only native status. Checking status does not approve a phone or start recovery.
pairing.statusUncertain: Current outcome is uncertain. The last observed state is not confirmation; refresh native status before approving.
pairing.qrAlt: Private Kloda LAN pairing QR code
pairing.qrFailed: The QR code could not be rendered. Cancel this invitation and create a new one.
pairing.scanInstruction: On your phone, open Kloda pairing and scan this QR code. Keep both devices on the same local network.
pairing.secretWarning: This QR code is a private invitation. Do not share it or let another device scan it.
pairing.qrUnavailable: The QR code is unavailable or its native lifetime has ended. It cannot be reused.
pairing.working: Waiting for the native pairing result…
pairing.loadingDescription: No pairing state has been confirmed yet.
pairing.unavailableDescription: Native pairing must be available before an invitation can be created.
pairing.revocationDescription: Revoking disables trust on this PC. It does not promise rollback or deletion of the phone’s record.
pairing.candidateUnavailable: The exact candidate could not be identified. Approval is disabled; cancel or refresh status.
pairing.noFileGrant: Device trust is not file permission. Pairing grants no access to files, folders or photos.
pairing.backupDescription: Choose a folder on this PC, then explicitly confirm permission in the native dialog. Permission covers this device’s selected files and photos and listing or restoring its own backup only. It does not allow deletion, access to another device’s files or two-way sync.
pairing.backupRevocationDescription: Revoking file permission keeps device trust and existing files. Folder failures can be retried without resetting pairing or deleting data.

backupStates.approved: Backup permission configured. This does not confirm a completed transfer or that the phone can reach this PC.
backupStates.unavailable: Backup scope unavailable. Refresh status or select the folder again.
backupStates.unknown: Current backup permission cannot be verified. The last observed folder is shown below; refresh native status.

pairing.approvalDescription: This candidate proved possession of the invitation on its live connection. Approve only if this is the phone you intended to pair. A phone that scanned a copied QR code could be the candidate.
pairing.explicitDecision: Use an explicit button. Clicking outside, Escape or Enter will not approve or dismiss this request.
pairing.repairDescription: Previous local trust for this exact phone key was revoked. Pair again establishes new device trust only; it does not clear existing file denies or grant file access.
pairing.resumeDescription: Pairing is not complete. Resume explicitly requests recovery of the retained record on a fresh authenticated LAN connection. No automatic network retry is started.
pairing.recoveryUnavailable: Native status did not provide a retained record to resume. Refresh status; do not assume pairing completed.
pairing.completedNotice: Local pairing is complete. No file permission was granted.
pairing.pendingNotice: PC trust was stored, but pairing is waiting for the phone’s acknowledgement.

phaseDescriptions.idle: Create an invitation when your phone is ready. No device is approved by opening this page.
phaseDescriptions.open: Only a live, unexpired native invitation can display a QR code.
phaseDescriptions.reserved: The QR code is hidden. The exact reserved candidate needs your explicit approval or denial.
phaseDescriptions.consumed_pending_ack: This PC durably stored the peer pin, but has not confirmed the phone’s acknowledgement. This is not pairing completion.
phaseDescriptions.complete: Native pairing completion was confirmed. File access still requires separate authorization.
phaseDescriptions.connecting: Native TLS and LAN checks are in progress. No successful pairing or durable peer trust is implied.
phaseDescriptions.pending: The retained pairing attempt needs a confirmed outcome. It is not a successful pairing.
phaseDescriptions.invalid: This invitation cannot be reused. A new invitation requires a new QR code.
phaseDescriptions.revoked: Local trust is disabled. A new pairing requires fresh explicit consent and does not clear file denies.

errors.invalid_qr: The pairing QR code is invalid.
errors.unsupported_version: This pairing version is unsupported. No downgrade was attempted.
errors.lan_unavailable: No supported direct Wi-Fi or Ethernet LAN route is available.
errors.native_unsupported: Native pairing is unavailable in this environment. Open a supported Kloda desktop build; browser previews cannot pair devices.
errors.identity_unavailable: The native device identity is unavailable or locked. Pairing has not been confirmed.
errors.continuity_lost: Device identity or installation continuity was lost. Existing pairing records cannot be adopted.
errors.tls_rejected: The native TLS identity or connection checks were rejected.
errors.proof_rejected: The invitation proof was rejected. No trust was granted.
errors.invitation_expired: The invitation expired. Create a new invitation; reconnecting cannot extend its lifetime.
errors.candidate_stale: This candidate or connection generation changed. Refresh status and make a new explicit decision.
errors.already_paired: This device is already paired. Existing trust was not overwritten.
errors.storage_failure: Native pairing storage failed. Completion cannot be assumed.
errors.connection_closed: The pairing connection closed. Check native status; use explicit resume if a retained record is available.
errors.outcome_unknown: The pairing outcome is unknown. Check native status before continuing.
errors.acl_busy: The native permission store is busy. Refresh status and retry.
errors.acl_unavailable: The native permission store is unavailable. Permission cannot be confirmed.
errors.backup_unavailable: The backup folder is unavailable. Reselect the folder and retry.
errors.backup_full: The backup target has no space or quota left. Free space or select another folder and approve again.
errors.backup_busy: The backup folder is currently in use or locked. Close the application using it and retry.
errors.backup_permission_denied: Access to the backup folder was denied. Check local permissions or reselect the folder.
errors.backup_path_rejected: The selected backup folder was rejected. Choose another folder.
errors.backup_scope_changed: The approved folder changed. Reselect it and explicitly approve again; do not reset pairing or delete files.
errors.revoked: Local pairing trust was revoked. Late replies cannot restore it.

background.title: Receiver status and background settings
background.unknown: Current background status cannot be verified.
background.listening: Local receiver is listening. This does not verify reachability from the phone.
background.unavailable: Local receiver is unavailable or not yet verified.
background.active: A backup or file connection is active.
background.backupFailed: The last WebDAV backup did not complete. Check WebDAV backup activity.
background.shutdownFailed: Safe quit failed. Kloda remains open; backup may have stopped. Check status and retry quitting.
background.sleepHint: Transfers are not guaranteed while the PC sleeps, is off, or after quitting Kloda.
background.environmentLimited: Tray/menu control is unverified in this session. The window stays visible with a Quit button. On Linux, first reopen the window using the Kloda tray menu.
background.loginQuestion: Start Kloda automatically when you log in to this computer?
background.loginEnabled: The operating system login-start entry is enabled.
background.loginNotApplied: Your enabled preference is not active in the operating system. Check system startup settings.

loginReasons.unpackaged: Login start is not configured for development builds; an installed Kloda package is required.
loginReasons.unsupported: This environment or package type does not support login start.
loginReasons.os_blocked: The operating system or desktop settings may be blocking login start.
loginReasons.unavailable: Operating system login-start status could not be read.
loginReasons.external_entry: Another startup entry was found and was not overwritten.
loginReasons.desktop_policy: The XDG startup entry is configured; Linux desktop policy may still prevent launch.

incoming.title: Incoming transfers and history
incoming.description: A read-only view of this PC’s native transfer journal, separate from WebDAV sending activity.
incoming.noAuthority: History is not current access permission. This screen does not start or resume transfers or grant file access.
incoming.missingMetadata: The journal stores no device display name, operation time or per-operation last error. Devices are identified by their key fingerprint; missing result details are not inferred.
incoming.byteMeaning: Bytes show the durable acknowledged offset in the journal, not a live connection. Whole-content SHA-256 verification and durable publication have finished only for “Completed in journal”.
incoming.order: Records are paged by operation ID; this is not chronological order.
incoming.unavailable: Current receiver/journal status cannot be verified or the receiver is unavailable. Any records below are historical information, not live transfers.
incoming.receiverError: Current receiver error (not attributed to a particular historical file):
incoming.empty: No recorded incoming transfers on this page.
incoming.pending: Incomplete. The recorded phase proves neither live work, success nor automatic recovery; continuation or retry may be needed.
incoming.stalePending: Incomplete. Showing the last recorded offset and phase; current transfer or completion is not verified.

devices.title: Paired devices and backup access
devices.description: Device identity is its native key fingerprint. Device names and online status are not recorded. Pairing trust and backup permission are separate. Granting access requires a visible, active window, folder selection and explicit confirmation.
devices.revokeMeaning: Revoking backup access preserves pairing trust and completed files.
devices.removeMeaning: Removing a device revokes its trust and file access on this computer, even if the phone is offline. Completed backups are kept; nothing is removed from the phone. Connecting again requires a new QR pairing and separate file access approval.
devices.order: Records are ordered by identifier, not by pairing time.
devices.unavailable: Current trust and permissions could not be verified. Previously shown permissions are unknown until a successful refresh.

trust.consumed_pending_ack: Awaiting pairing acknowledgement; no access approval

permission.approved: Approved for this device’s own backup only

receiver.title: Home
receiver.description: Backups from your phones are stored here, in the folder you choose.
receiver.listenerBoundary: Listener availability is not a file permission or a guarantee that a phone can reach this computer. Check each device’s backup area and permission separately.
receiver.pairDescription: Create a local QR invitation and explicitly approve the phone. Pairing establishes trust; it does not give file access.
receiver.accessTitle: Choose an area and allow access
receiver.accessDescription: After pairing, select the device’s separate backup folder and explicitly confirm file access. Existing devices can be managed here.
receiver.trustBoundary: No folder or explicit approval means no file access. A pairing confirmation or a successful WebDAV test does not complete receiver setup.
receiver.devicesDescription: Review actual peer identities, trust, backup areas and file permissions.
receiver.incomingDescription: See durable byte progress and previous transfer results.
receiver.settingsDescription: Background operation, start at login and the observed operating-system state.
receiver.advancedDescription: Advanced WebDAV sends selected files from this computer to a separate destination. Its setup and results are independent of incoming phone backups.
receiver.backupsDescription: Manage backup versions; restore within 30 days.

backups.title: Backup versions
backups.description: Only completed backups managed by Kloda. Removing a device does not delete backups; phone originals remain untouched. Photos versions appear separately; shared media needed by retained and recoverable versions is preserved.
backups.retention: Deletion moves this backup version to recoverable trash for 30 days. Permanent cleanup runs automatically on expiry, or when Kloda next opens if it was closed. Restore uses the former target and never overwrites another file.
backups.suppression: An unchanged deleted source is not uploaded again automatically. Rebackup requires an explicit request on the phone; a changed source is a separate version.
backups.unavailable: The current backup state could not be verified. Last observed records are historical and cannot be acted on. Refresh to retry.
backups.empty: No completed backups can be listed.
backups.emptyTrash: No trash records can be listed.
backups.selectPage: Select all available versions on this page
backups.selectionScope: Selection is retained across pages. Selecting all verifies up to 4096 records; process larger lists page by page.
backups.manifestBytes: Metadata record: {{bytes}} bytes; not the shared media total

states.unavailable: File identity or backup scope could not be verified; actions are unavailable.

errors.outcome_unknown: Completion was not verified. Check the current state before retrying.
errors.conflict: Another file occupies the target or the file identity changed. Nothing was overwritten; resolve the conflict.
errors.backup_scope_changed: The backup area identity changed; safe action is unavailable.
errors.backup_unavailable: The backup or required metadata is unavailable. Success was not verified.
errors.backup_busy: The backup is in use. Retry after transfer or restore finishes.

backups.selectAll: Select available versions on all pages
backups.selectionError: Could not select all versions: records were unreadable or the 4096-record limit was exceeded. The previous selection is retained; you can select page by page.

ui.skipDescription: Open the home screen without adding sources or connections. This grants no pairing trust or file access.
ui.noConnectionsDescription: Add a backup destination. Phone pairing and incoming backups are managed separately under Receiver.
ui.connectionsUnavailable: The saved destination could not be read. Current connection status is unknown.
ui.savedNotLive: A saved destination and previous test do not prove current reachability or a successful backup.
ui.existingWebdavDescription: Use the existing source, destination and connection-test flow. The password is not displayed here.
ui.providerUnavailable: The actual connection for this provider is not implemented yet.
ui.providerFuture: Connection options are shown as part of the design. This screen does not sign in to an account or start a transfer.
ui.trayDescription: On supported systems Kloda can be reopened from the system tray or menu bar. The actual receiver and quit controls are above. A visible window is retained if the environment has no tray support.
ui.welcomeDescription: Backups from your phones are stored here, in the folder you choose.
ui.connectionsDescription: Send folders on this computer to cloud or network storage. Incoming phone backups are not in this list.

fields.hostKeyHint: Verify the server fingerprint from its own source on first connect.
